title: Accounting Beyond Compliance — Who Closes the AI Skills Gap?
subtitle: IMA India’s country head says accounting education must leave the compliance-only classroom. APAC CFOs already treat AI as a force remaking the function. A composite beverage CFO must decide whether campus hiring still buys a close calendar.
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 25 September 2026 covering IMA India curriculum remarks, Wolters Kluwer APAC CFO survey (83%/72%), CleanSpark CFO skills-gap note, Deloitte 1.6x/2.5x human-capital findings, U.S. accounting enrolment 266,507, and composite firm Kalinga Beverage Systems Ltd.
thumbnail: 83% OF APAC CFOs SAY AI IS RESHAPING FINANCE. IMA INDIA SAYS THE CLASSROOM MUST LEAVE COMPLIANCE-ONLY ACCOUNTING.
